title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
layout_note: A directed graphical model: one row of circular latent nodes x_T ... x_t, x_{t-1} ... x_0 joined by arrows, with one step pair singled out by a labelled forward arrow above and a dashed backward arc below.
grouping: No containers at all; the chain is one row and the 'middle' step is set apart only by its two labelled arrows and the ellipsis arrows on either side.
shapes_depth: Flat circles with black outlines, latent nodes filled mid-grey and the data node x_0 left white; small square noisy-image thumbnails hang under-right of x_T, x_{t-1} and x_0; no shadows.
proposed_highlight: No colour; the learned reverse step p_theta(x_{t-1}|x_t) is the one solid labelled arrow above the chain, and the fixed forward step q(x_t|x_{t-1}) is a dashed arc running back underneath it.
lesson: Explain an iterative process by drawing the whole chain with ellipses and labelling only one representative step, with the learned direction solid above and the fixed direction dashed below.
notes: Venue from the first page (NeurIPS 2020). Figure 2 is the only diagram; Figure 1 is a sample grid. Caption calls it the directed graphical model.

arrangement.units: no enclosed regions; one row of nodes
arrangement.inputs_as: a grey node x_T with a pure-noise thumbnail below it

core.what: the diffusion process as one horizontal Markov chain of circled states x_T -> ... -> x_t -> x_{t-1} -> ... -> x_0, one step expanded with the reverse transition above and the forward transition below

relations.form: six nodes on one left-to-right axis with ellipsis arrows hiding intermediate steps; one step x_t -> x_{t-1} drawn long and labelled
the generative p_theta(x_{t-1}|x_t) solid arrow above and the forward q(x_t|x_{t-1}) dashed curved arrow below face each other across the same pair of nodes
a small image thumbnail at the lower right of x_T, x_{t-1} and x_0 shows the sample going from pure noise to a face

channels.colour: grey node fill = latent noisy state, white = the data x_0 (not keyed); thumbnails are the only colour
channels.line: solid arrow = the learned reverse process p_theta; dashed curved arrow = the fixed forward noising q

quality.strengths: The chain's direction is the generative order and the two processes are separated by line style and side (p above solid, q below dashed, opposite directions), so the forward/reverse pair is legible as geometry; thumbnails show data as data.
quality.weaknesses: Grey vs white node fill is an unkeyed second code; thumbnails sit off-centre to the lower right of the nodes and only three states have one; the transitions are typeset formulas next to the arrows rather than names.

insights.structure: Six circular nodes in a single horizontal row, x_T on the left to x_0 on the right, with ellipsis arrows hiding the intermediate steps.
insights.data: Each sampled state is a small square image thumbnail tucked under its node, going from pure noise under x_T to a partly denoised face under x_{t-1} to a clean face under x_0.
insights.emphasis: The one expanded step x_t -> x_{t-1} carries the only equation labels: p_theta solid above and q dashed below, so the two distributions the paper defines are the focus.
insights.flow: Read left to right along the generative direction; the only backward line is the dashed forward-noising arc curving under the highlighted step.
insights.avoid: The data node x_0 is drawn white while all other nodes are grey with no key, and the thumbnails sit off-centre beside the nodes, so the mapping of image to node is loose.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
